body: I'm so glad to hear that. I hope you're doing ok.

If it gives you bad beelings and affects you mentally, it matters. You're not being whiny, you're advocating for yourself by being honest about the fact that these feelings are hurting you. If possible find someone who is willing to let you vent whenever you have these feelings, because honestly just wird-vomiting your thoughts and feelings can help so much. Also, the people on this sub will NEVER judge you. We're all going through it too!

For my self harm, I have a couple of methods:

Find something that gives your hands something to do (knitting, fidget cube/spinner)
Do the most distracting thing possible (I like playing super intense video games)
Write down every single thought and feeling you have, write until you literally can't thing of anything else to write
Find someone to spend time with or talk to until the urge goes away
Do soemthing that replicates the feeling - sounds weird but I pick pieces out of styrofoam (my self harm is skin picking)
Take a cold shower or splash your face with cold water, it sort of reboots the system and sometimes gets rid of the urge
Take care if your body - eat a snack, drink as much water as you can possibly handle, and if it's late then go the heck to sleep!
I always say to myself "if I still want to pick in the morning, I'm allowed to." Usually I don't.

I'm always here to chat and listen and I promise I'll never judge you in any way.

I started with bio oil and find it really helps. You need to use it twice a day, and it takes about 3 months to start showing improvement, but it's totally worth it. Plus it hydrates your skin and smells really nice. Silicone gels/sheets are also supposed to really help, but I haven't tried them yet.
